wandb.notes: First full-length MULTI-GPU run (4x GH200, gates/training/distributed.py). Identical parameters to the single-GPU arm joint150_bg0p1_trunkfp5e-5_bg5e-6 of the head-LR sweep (W&B run kyqkwfbu, job 6500993: train 2014+2015 / test 2016, continuous joint 150 epochs, bg_loss_weight 0.1, trunk/fp 5e-5, bg 5e-6, deterministic) EXCEPT distributed.num_gpus=4: batch_size 5 is per GPU, so the effective batch is 20 and each epoch has 4x fewer optimizer steps. Learning rates deliberately NOT rescaled. Purpose: measure wall-time speed-up and the effect of the larger effective batch on fp/bg test losses vs kyqkwfbu (fp 0.429@146, bg 0.099@144).
